# Aditya Pratap

> 20-year-old AI builder and motion designer from Jhansi, India.

## Who is Aditya Pratap?

Aditya Pratap is a 20-year-old AI builder and motion designer from Jhansi, India, and a final-year B.Sc. (Hons) Biotechnology student at Bundelkhand University, Jhansi. He builds real AI products used by real people: ReelForge (AI promo-video service), BanaoBot (WhatsApp bot platform for small businesses), PortfolioForge (GitHub-to-portfolio generator), SarkariRadar (government scheme eligibility engine), and AQI Alarm (air quality alerts for India). He also runs VEYRO Motion & Visuals, a motion-design studio, and contributes to open source daily on GitHub.
